announcement.text: 🔥 NEW: Phone Number Persistence is live! Lock your favorite number, pay a small monthly fee, free renewal if you use it this month!

longTerm.title: Phone Persistence: Keep Your Number Forever
longTerm.subtitle: Want to use the same number long-term? Lock it after receiving an SMS, pay a small monthly fee, and the number is yours. Used it this month? Next month renews for free!

lock.title: One-Click Lock
lock.desc: Click the lock icon after receiving an SMS to add the number to your long-term list

fee.title: Fee = First Price
fee.desc: Monthly fee equals the service price you paid when first locking the number — fully transparent

renew.title: Use Once, Renew Free
renew.desc: If you receive at least one SMS with the number this month, next month renews automatically for free

grace.title: 7-Day Grace Period
grace.desc: If your balance runs low, you get a 7-day window to top up or adjust — the number won't be released immediately

longTerm.rule1: When you receive SMS for other services, you're charged the current real-time price of that service
longTerm.rule2: Enabled by default; deducts from balance when sufficient. Toggle off in My Long-Term Numbers
longTerm.rule3: Failed renewals trigger a 7-day grace period — number reserved but SMS paused; released to public pool afterwards
longTerm.lockedToastDesc: ${{price}} deducted. Manage in My Long-Term Numbers.
longTerm.tabIntroDesc: Locked numbers stay yours. Monthly fee = first-lock service price; use it this month and next month is free; insufficient balance triggers a 7-day grace period.
longTerm.empty: No long-term numbers yet. Go to Receive SMS, get a number, and click the lock icon to keep it.
